task: Expose the committed `verification` skill to Codex CLI (which discovers skills under .agents/skills/) without maintaining a second copy, and point the skill at AGENTS.md now that AGENTS.md is the canonical rules file

events.summary: Working tree on 2026-09-07 carried an untracked .agents/skills/verification/SKILL.md (created 2026-09-03) that differed from the committed .claude/skills/verification/SKILL.md by exactly one token: the version-bump paragraph said 'see AGENTS.md' instead of 'see CLAUDE.md'. Nothing on main tracks .agents/skills/.
events.provenance: git status --short; diff .claude/skills/verification/SKILL.md .agents/skills/verification/SKILL.md; git ls-tree -r origin/main --name-only | grep .agents/skills

events.summary: Two readers (Claude Code: .claude/skills; Codex CLI: .agents/skills) need one skill. Chose a symlink .agents/skills/verification -> ../../.claude/skills/verification over a second tracked copy so the two cannot drift, and fixed the single stale reference so the skill points at AGENTS.md, which is where the four-site Go version-bump gotcha now lives (CLAUDE.md is only the @AGENTS.md bridge). Not touched: skill content, other .agents/** files, any workflow.

Before changing anything: `diff .claude/skills/verification/SKILL.md .agents/skills/verification/SKILL.md` printed exactly one differing line (41c41, CLAUDE.md vs AGENTS.md); `git check-ignore` showed .agents/skills is not ignored, so the copy would either be committed as a drifting duplicate or lost; `grep -n 'four places' AGENTS.md` confirmed the referenced gotcha lives in AGENTS.md, not CLAUDE.md, so the committed skill's pointer was already stale.
sed replaced 'see `CLAUDE.md`' with 'see `AGENTS.md`' in .claude/skills/verification/SKILL.md; removed the untracked copy and added the relative symlink under .agents/skills/.

cat through the symlink returns the skill text; grep confirms AGENTS.md contains the 'Go version bump touches four places' gotcha the skill now references; no Go, chart, workflow, or Dockerfile file changed so the Go/CI suites are not affected by this diff.
events.scope: Docs/agent-config only. Whether Codex CLI actually follows the symlink when enumerating .agents/skills is not verified here (Codex quota exhausted at the time); Claude Code reads the .claude path directly and is unaffected.

events.summary: Skill single-sourced under .claude/skills, mirrored to .agents/skills by symlink, stale CLAUDE.md pointer corrected; gate.py and check-agent-trace-evidence.py pass locally for this trace.
Skill is single-sourced under .claude/skills and mirrored to Codex's discovery path by symlink; stale CLAUDE.md reference corrected.
